name: Distinct three-term unit-fraction representations of 4/n
description: construct() -> 254 rows for n=3..256. Each row is None or three DISTINCT positive integer denominators x,y,z<=1000000000000 with 1/x+1/y+1/z=4/n. Maximize fraction solved. Equality is checked by cross multiplication and malformed claims invalidate the candidate. Construct distinct positive denominators for n=3..256, with denominator bound10^12. The prize bank requires distinctness, which is stricter than the paper’s general solution definition; no universal proof or published computation is reproduced.

state_of_the_art.statement: For every n from 3 to 256, 4/n is a sum of three distinct unit fractions with denominators far below 10^12 (found for every n by scripts/check_state_of_the_art.py), so the maximum fraction is 1. The general statement is Erdős Problem #242.
